description: Keeps an existing Amazon RDS DB instance running or stopped, with RDS's StartDBInstance and StopDBInstance. A deploy starts or stops the DB instance only when its state differs from the template's. RDS starts a stopped DB instance on its own after 7 days, and the next deploy stops it again. Deleting it changes nothing in AWS: the DB instance stays as it is.

DBInstanceIdentifier.description: The identifier of the DB instance. RDS stores it in lowercase. A DB instance of an Aurora DB cluster starts and stops only with its cluster, and one of a Multi-AZ DB cluster can't be stopped.

State.description: The state to keep the DB instance in: running or stopped. A read returns running for every status in which the DB instance runs, such as available or backing-up, and RDS's status while it starts or stops, such as starting.

DBInstanceStatus.description: The status RDS reports for the DB instance, such as available, backing-up, or stopped.
